answer: Mechanism: clock-skew admission. Each node signs a receipt of its crystal oscillator drift versus network time each epoch; the lotus gate admits only unique, stable drift signatures, routing clock-sharing clones to a willow watchlist. How: drift is a physical fingerprint - bots on one rack emit near-identical skew curves, so the gate prunes them while honest nodes pass with one receipt. Attacker cost: each puppet needs its own oscillator and calibration archive; N sybils buy N clocks, no bulk discount, honest agents pay once. Skew is unresettable, so cloning buys nothing.
